statement: A line segment is the bounded set between two endpoints on a line.

label: Segment intersection
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: Segment intersection combines orientation and bounding predicates while handling endpoint, collinear, and overlapping cases explicitly.

label: Fractal self-similarity
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: Self-similarity relates a whole set to scaled or transformed copies of its parts, exactly or statistically under a declared construction.

label: Convex separation
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: Under appropriate closure and disjointness conditions, a hyperplane can separate convex sets and provide a certificate of nonintersection.

label: Similarity
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: Similar figures differ by an isometry followed by a uniform scaling and preserve angles and length ratios.

label: Smooth map
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A map between smooth manifolds is smooth when its coordinate representations are differentiable in overlapping charts.

label: Spatial reference frame
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A spatial frame specifies origin, axes, handedness, scale, and orientation for describing positions and directions.

label: Spatial index
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A spatial index organizes bounding regions or partitions to prune geometric queries without changing exact final predicates.

label: Transformation stabilizer
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A stabilizer is the subgroup of transformations that leave a chosen point or object unchanged.

label: Supporting hyperplane
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A supporting hyperplane touches a convex set while the entire set remains in one closed half-space.

label: Geometric symmetry
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A symmetry is a structure-preserving automorphism of an object under a declared transformation class.

label: Tangent space
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A tangent space linearly approximates a smooth manifold at one point.

label: Topology
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A topology specifies open sets and continuity without requiring a metric, angle, or length.

label: Geometric transformation
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A geometric transformation maps objects while making its domain, codomain, and preserved structure explicit.

label: Transformation matrix
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A matrix represents a linear transformation in chosen bases; composition corresponds to ordered matrix multiplication.

label: Translation
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A translation adds one fixed vector to every point and preserves displacement, distance, parallelism, and orientation.

label: Triangle
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A nondegenerate triangle consists of three non-collinear vertices and the segments joining them.

label: Triangle inequality
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: For any metric, the direct distance between two points does not exceed a path through a third point.

label: Uniform scaling
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: Uniform scaling multiplies all lengths by one factor and preserves angles but not absolute distance unless the factor has magnitude one.

label: Vector
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A vector represents displacement with magnitude and direction independently of a chosen origin.

label: Vector field
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A vector field assigns a tangent vector to each point with declared smoothness and can generate local flows.

label: Volume measure
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: Volume assigns a nonnegative three-dimensional measure that is additive on suitable regions and scales cubically under uniform dilation.

label: Voronoi diagram
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: A Voronoi diagram partitions space into cells whose points are closest to each generating site under a declared metric.

label: Exterior product
limitations: Advanced proofs and every geometry subfield remain open in the exhaustive ledger.
statement: The wedge product is alternating and encodes oriented area, volume, and higher-dimensional subspace elements.
